'''Sariyah Budan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] and the leader of the [[Sungrazer cooperative]], an organization that used [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] for deadly [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. Based on the ''[[Sungrazer]]'', the organization received the slaves from [[the Crucible]] and forced them to mine [[Thorilide/Legends|thorilide]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] on the [[Comet/Legends|comets]]. In [[3963 BBY]], [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Jarael]] attempted to free the slaves from the ''Sungrazer'' by posing as members of the Crucible, but Budan cracked the con and called for [[Gladiator (Crucible)|''Gladiator'']] - an actual Crucible vessel to detain the pretenders.
